opening.argument: The video centers on children's aspirations and a forward-looking message about opportunity and advocacy. One speaker states, "I will become a scientist," while another wants "to give a voice to those who don't have it." It connects those ambitions to the RBC Kids Pledge, saying it is "working to make that happen," and describes RBC's reported $100 million pledge to help children reach their goals. The closing invitation to learn more does not request payment, credentials, investment participation, or any other deceptive action. The material therefore presents a youth-focused message and organizational pledge, with no indicated financial loss or harmful outcome.

citations.quote: I want to give a voice to those who don't have it.
through the RBC Kids Pledge we’re working to make that happen.
